card.description: Heaven is an infinite, sterile environment that functions as a central mainframe core. A vast floor of polished obsidian black mirror stretches to the horizon, its surface etched with faint, bioluminescent liquid light circuits that pulse in sync with unseen data streams. Above, a blinding white singularity radiates, casting a high‑key, clinical glow that illuminates the entire space. The environment fuses ancient Ethiopian/Egyptian motifs—intricate glyphs and crystalline hardware—within an incomprehensible, advanced technological framework. It serves as a clean‑room server, a place where golden light particles swirl into abstract shapes, and a stage for levitating figures surrounded by orbiting artifacts.
visual_anatomy: **Body/Form:** Infinite black obsidian floor, polished to mirror finish, extending beyond visible horizon; embedded glowing liquid light circuit patterns; no visible walls, creating a sense of boundlessness.
**Face/Sensors:** Central white singularity at the center of the void, radiating pure white light; data streams emanate from the singularity, visible as faint golden threads across the floor.

**Key Features:** Bioluminescent circuit patterns, crystalline glyphs etched into floor, white singularity, golden light particles forming abstract shapes, orbiting artifacts (tetrahedron, gyro, cube).
evolution: Phase 1 (Pristine Core): Infinite obsidian floor with glowing circuits, white singularity, sterile white void.
Phase 2 (Sealed Sky): Massive mechanical iris slides shut, sky turns grey, golden light dims, environment becomes sealed.
props: Item: Orbiting Artifacts (Tetrahedron, Gyro, Cube) orbiting the central figure.
card.prompt_block: A cinematic, hyper-realistic 8k vertical 9:16 shot of Heaven's central mainframe core: an infinite floor of polished obsidian black mirror etched with faint bioluminescent liquid light circuits, reflecting a blinding white singularity that radiates high-key clinical light; the sterile white void above is punctuated by swirling golden light particles forming abstract shapes, while orbiting artifacts—a tetrahedron, a gyro, and a cube—glide around the center; ancient Ethiopian/Egyptian glyphs and crystalline hardware adorn the floor, creating an industrial mysticism aesthetic that feels grounded yet incomprehensibly advanced.
